title: Reading: At the airport
goal: Check in, pass security and find your gate.
goal_it: Fare il check-in e trovare il gate.

steps.title: Key phrases
en: Learn these phrases first. You will meet them in the dialogue.
it: Impara prima queste frasi. Le ritroverai nel dialogo.

head: English
Italiano
rows: Where is the check-in desk for flight BA 612?
Dov'è il banco check-in per il volo BA 612?
I'd like to check in, please.
Vorrei fare il check-in, per favore.
Do you have any bags to check in?
Can I take this as hand luggage?
Posso portarlo come bagaglio a mano?
Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
Preferisce il posto finestrino o corridoio?

steps.title: At the check-in desk
en: Read the conversation between Anna and the airline agent.
Agent: Good morning. Where are you flying to today?
Anna: Good morning. I'm flying to Edinburgh.
Agent: May I see your passport, please?
Agent: Do you have any bags to check in?
Anna: Just this suitcase. I'd like to take the small bag as hand luggage.
Agent: That's fine. Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
Agent: Here is your boarding card. Your gate is 14, and boarding starts at ten past nine.
Anna: Thank you. Is the flight on time?
Agent: Yes, it is. Have a good flight!
it: Leggi la conversazione tra Anna e l'addetto della compagnia aerea.
Addetto: Posso vedere il passaporto, per favore?
Anna: Solo questa valigia. Vorrei portare la borsa piccola come bagaglio a mano.
Addetto: Va bene. Preferisce il posto finestrino o corridoio?
Addetto: Ecco la carta d'imbarco. Il gate è il 14 e l'imbarco inizia alle nove e dieci.
Anna: Grazie. Il volo è in orario?

steps.why: She says: I'm flying to Edinburgh.
She checks in the suitcase. The small bag is hand luggage.
steps.why_it: Imbarca la valigia. La borsa piccola è bagaglio a mano.

steps.q: Excuse me, where is the ___ desk for flight BA 612?
steps.q_it: Scusi, dov'è il banco per il volo BA 612?
steps.why: The check-in desk is where you leave your bags and get your boarding card.
steps.why_it: Il banco check-in è dove lasci i bagagli e ricevi la carta d'imbarco.

steps.q: Can I take this bag ___ hand luggage?
steps.q_it: Posso portare questa borsa come bagaglio a mano?

steps.q: Would you like a window seat ___ an aisle seat?
steps.q_it: Preferisce il posto finestrino o corridoio?
steps.why: We use or to offer a choice.
steps.why_it: Usiamo or per offrire una scelta.

answers: Can I take this as hand luggage
steps.why: Can I + base verb is a polite way to ask permission.
steps.why_it: Can I + verbo base è un modo gentile per chiedere il permesso.

cards.ex: The flight is delayed by an hour.
I'd like a window seat, please.
Do you prefer an aisle seat?
